_about: Labeled receipt/invoice corpus for the content classifier (specs 02/07, content-classifier Phase 1 rule scorer + Phase 2 LLM). Each entry's `text` is the document body the classifier reads (_classification_text). `label` is the two-axis ground truth (genre + paid) plus the document_type the full Step-6 cascade should reach. `difficulty`: keyword = obvious phrases the rule scorer catches; semantic = no trigger phrases (LLM only); adversarial = paid invoices / unpaid receipts / non-bills that expose a naive classifier. See README.md.
